No observed redundant-copy, out-of-span-tail or obsolete-membership component supplies a causal prefix-closed DROP rule. This is a measured admission-design blocker, not R2 completion or proof that the workload has no possible value policy.

Conversely, positive next-use association does not prove all preceding body seconds necessary. The old full-parent 0/4 floor is not relabeled as a block-second floor.

causal_signal.unresolved_condition: Identify a decision-time causal distinction permitting removal while preserving leading-prefix closure and actual savings. Excluding this uncovered leading ancestor while retaining descendants is not prefix-closed; predicting later safe reacquisition from recorded arrivals is future leakage. Disarming only while idle and rearming before every draw would relabel unchanged protection rather than establish marginal admission.
causal_signal.other_observed_components: No alternative-copy exposure, no out-of-declared-span preferred tail, and no future exposure after the last cached-copy adoption were found.
causal_signal.runtime_features: Existing definite-future declarations, current cache hash/depth identities, native refs/free links, request status and cached logical-copy availability only. No future q3 identity/time/text/outcome or probe-count value label.
causal_signal.evaluation_only: Physical-copy next/last native cached-prefix adoptions and matched scheduled recompute. These are not attention-kernel access timestamps and never enter runtime admission.
